TEXT: On the way back home from our noisy date.
We walk slowly together, side by side.

We used to walk home together like this countless 
times when we were young.
At some point, we became distant.

But we got closer again, thanks to the life 
consultation that started it all...

And although we frequently had opportunities to 
walk home together.

Today was different from the times we did so 
before.
We were walking home together, as lovers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...We got found out by Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Never thought we would meet in a place like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, I suppose it's only natural to come across 
otakus in Akiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: She was really surprised.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Haha. She was so surprised that she talked in otaku 
mode even though her true appearance was 
revealed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Shouldn't we just tell everyone?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: About how we're going out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I want Kuroneko to hear it from us rather than 
from Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: And Ayase too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ayase, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: If you lay a hand on Kirino, I'll kill you!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I might end up dead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...Have you forgotten what happened during last 
year's Summer Comiket?

We ran into Ayase, who hated otakus then, while we 
were carrying bags full of doujinshi... and then 
various things happened after that.
That was a terrible experience.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It'll be fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=26]It's not fine at all![/font_size] I've been on the brink of 
death by that girl's high kick!

Her attack was on such a level that, if this were a 
video game, a criminal act warning label would 
have to be attached to the game package.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Isn't that because you did something that made 
her kick you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
But I only asked that she wear a Thanatos Eros 
cosplay, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [font_size=33]That's almost nude!! Die!!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You got it all wrong, it was for your sake!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Don't make excuses! Pervert!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Gah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Anyway... If it's Ayase, it'll be fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I have nothing to do with it if you end up kicked as 
a natural consequence for your own misdeeds, 
though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You trust her a lot, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Of course.

As she said that and smiled, Kirino's face was 
brimming with faith in her friend.
